text: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants should be non-Chinese citizens in good health both mentally and physically with a high school graduation certificate or equivalent. 2. Applicants for the Chinese-taught majors of Science, Engineering, Agriculture, Medicine, Economics, Management and Art should submit the certificate of HSK level 4 with the score of 180 points or above; Those in the Chinese-taught majors of Literature or Law should submit the certificate of HSK level 5 with the score of 180 points or above. 3. China Scholastic Competency Assessment Transcript This assessment is organized by the China Scholarship Counicl on behalf of the Ministry of Education of People’s Republic of China. All applicants must take the assessment in advance and get the score report. The assessment contents includes professional Chinese, mathematics, physics and chemistry. Professional Chinese Professional Chinese offers two types of tests: liberal arts Chinese and science Chinese. Applicants who apply for undergraduate studies taught in Chinese should take the corresponding professional Chinese test based on your applied major. Applicants who apply for English-medium undergraduate degree education do not need to take the professional Chinese test. Fundamental subjects All applicants must take mathematics test. According to different majors, applicants must participate in physics and chemistry tests after confirming with Northeast Forestry University. Language used for testing Assessments for mathematics, physics, and chemistry are available in both Chinese and English. Applicants can choose the language of the test paper based on the teaching language.
